# The files TestNoIssueRefs admits with a link to an issue of this repository:
# each is deleted by the unit the row names. A row is `path<TAB>unit`; a path
# that ends in / is a directory. A row that admits no link fails, so the list
# only shrinks.
docs/conformance.md	TOOLING
docs/decisions.md	PRINCIPLES
docs/receipts/	RECEIPTS
docs/research/	DEL-RESEARCH
docs/specs/custom-lint.md	SPECS-CITED
docs/specs/formatting.md	SPECS-CITED
docs/testing.md	TOOLING
docs/wayfinder/	WAYFINDER
